name: no-time
label: NO-TIME
title: No time to type
summary: Most of my work is steered by thumb, from a phone, through Claude Code's /remote-control, away from the keyboard. So the agents have to act safely while nobody watches every step, and cheaply when they do the same thing again. Hypermedia gives the first (only what the state allows is offered); kept scripts give the second (zero tokens to replay).
